_about: Image history index for the recycled-context check (ADR-017). Each entry is a known image: its 64-bit pHash (16 hex chars), the earliest date it is known to have appeared, and the pages it appeared on. An upload matches an entry when their pHash Hamming distance is at or below the configured threshold. THESE ENTRIES ARE ILLUSTRATIVE: the images are author-generated by backend/scripts/build_image_index.py and the sources are fictional example.com pages (RFC 2606) carried over from the pre-WP-1 fixture. Real entries come from dataset A.
